x-notes: PRODUCTION. Runs scripts/migrate.py up and exits. THE TASK ROLE CHANGED FROM DEV, deliberately: dev carries imageshield-dev-services, so a schema migration could index, search and delete faces. scripts/migrate.py imports only imageshield.db.dsn, opens Postgres and exits; it makes no AWS call, so it is given no AWS credentials to misuse. imageshield-prod-no-aws is the same role the fetcher uses for the same reason, and the backend's own migration task carries no role at all. The execution role still reads the secret, which is what a migration needs. ENVIRONMENT and LOG_LEVEL are carried for symmetry with the other files and are inert here: migrate.py never constructs Config, so nothing reads them. They are set to production and info anyway, so that a future migration step that does load Config does not inherit a dev posture.
